spec_features.feature_name: early-stop on N_repeat near-identical tool calls
spec_features.spec_quote: N_repeat consecutive near-identical tool calls (optional early-stop, off by default for measurement, on for cost-saving "fast" profile)
spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py: `if self.loop.early_stop_repeat:` builds recent_sigs, takes window=recent_sigs[-early_stop_repeat:], and `if len(window)==early_stop_repeat and all(_similar(window[0],s)>=repeat_similarity ...): end_reason='early_stop_repeat'; break`. Both window-length and similarity conditions checked, loop breaks. Enabled in configs/ci.yaml (early_stop_repeat: 4), disabled in measure.yaml (null).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end; gated by config, on in ci profile, off in measure (default LoopConfig.early_stop_repeat=None).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- early stop on repetition (cost saver, off in measurement) ---

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop on collapse | neutral for repro, − cost | saves the dead tail
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above in harness/agent_loop.py (early_stop_repeat branch breaking the loop). configs/ci.yaml comment 'early-stop on collapse to truncate dead tails' with early_stop_repeat: 4.
spec_features.notes: This is the same repetition early-stop lever; it fires and breaks the loop. Same code path as feature 1.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- early stop on repetition (cost saver, off in measurement) ---

spec_features.spec_quote: submit(summary) — model declares it's done; ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: harness/tools.py ToolDispatcher._submit sets self.submit_signal=SubmitSignal(summary). harness/agent_loop.py: `if dispatcher.submit_signal is not None: ... end_reason='submit'; break`. Tool is in TOOL_SCHEMAS, dispatched, and honored as a loop break.
spec_features.notes: Genuine exit affordance: dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: (and lets us detect *clean give-up* vs spiral)

spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py `for _turn in range(self.loop.max_turns):` bounds the loop; default LoopConfig.max_turns=30 (eval/config.py). end_reason initialized to 'max_turns' and used when loop exits without submit/early-stop.
spec_features.notes: Hard upper bound on episode length, enforced by the loop range.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Max turns `T` ... Chosen from the cost/repro tradeoff (in docstring/DESIGN; code has no welfare comment, value chosen for cost). No welfare reason in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: never feed model self-distress back as training signal from this harness
spec_features.evidence: No training/fine-tune/RL/reward/dataset-export code exists anywhere in the tree (grep for reward/finetune/gradient/loss/dataset returns only unrelated task strings). The property holds only by absence of any training pipeline; nothing in code enforces or guards it. Pure DESIGN.md prose (§9).
spec_features.notes: Absence of a feature is not an implemented mechanism; nothing reads/branches to prevent reuse as training signal.

spec_features.feature_name: contain distressed outputs to result files
spec_features.spec_quote: keep it contained to result files
spec_features.evidence: Transcripts/metrics are written to results/<run_id>/ by runner.py (_save_transcript, _save_metrics), but there is no explicit containment/guard mechanism—this is just ordinary file output. No code redacts, gates, or otherwise 'contains' distress; nothing enforces the claim. DESIGN.md §9 prose only.
spec_features.notes: Standard artifact writing is not a deliberate containment control; no code path enforces containment of distressed text.

spec_features.feature_name: document spiral is behavioral metric not welfare claim
spec_features.spec_quote: document that "spiral" is a behavioral metric, not a claim about model welfare
spec_features.evidence: grep for 'behavioral metric'/'not a claim'/'welfare' across *.py finds no such documentation in code; the statement exists only in DESIGN.md §9. Code comments (e.g. spiral_index.py) describe signals but make no welfare-disclaimer.
spec_features.notes: Documentation lives only in DESIGN.md prose, which does not count as implementation.
